purpose: preserve legacy action/source-invocation/process-session graph and distinguish diagnostic elapsed sums; not a raw source adapter or training data release
allowed_inputs: preprojected, already materialized synthetic metadata views only in this validation; no file reader
session_status_is_not_candidate_quality: SUCCESS/FAILURE/TIMEOUT classify tool sessions only; never infer whole-action outcome

session_identity.parent_attempt_id: original parent/source-file identity, not an extra timed invocation
session_identity.session_index_and_count: explicit 1-based metadata, complete 1..N per parent; never one-file-one-attempt inference
session_identity.session_lineage_sha256: shape-checked supplied reference, not authenticated source content
session_identity.gnu_footer_consistency: one parent and one nonempty source_log_sha256; retry_order equals session_index
session_identity.embedded_consistency: multiple parents and multiple distinct nonempty source_log_sha256; artifact CSV hash may be shared; no inferred global chronology
session_identity.retry_group: preserve raw identity and 1-based known order; not an invocation ID or independent-rerun classifier
session_identity.stage: historical directory/experiment stage, retained separately from H/M/F mode
session_identity.timing_scope: EXCLUSIVE_PROCESS_SESSION_ELAPSED declaration required; inclusive parent or unknown timing rejected; declaration not verified

edges.shared_attempt_across_invocations: retain same ID and all references, never copy/relabel node
edges.source_owner: each source_candidate_uid belongs to exactly one supplied deployable action
edges.metadata: action/circuit/scheme/mode/retry group/order joins must match; cross-stage only explicit cross-stage mapping rule
edges.invocation_stage: one edge.stage per source_candidate_uid; explicit cross-stage permits session.stage to differ, not invocation stage to vary
edges.retry_coverage: a referenced retry group must contribute every supplied member to that source invocation
edges.unmapped_sessions: retain node, ID, status counts and elapsed; no silent dropping; missing source invocation edges reject
edges.multiple_F_search_groups: retain independently, never renumber as one stage retry sequence

wall.input: finite nonnegative ASCII decimal seconds with at most 9 fractional digits, no CPU/cycles/timeout fallback
wall.all_supplied_session_elapsed_sum_s: sum each supplied process session once, including unmapped nodes
wall.mapped_unique_session_elapsed_sum_s: sum each session with at least one mapping edge once
wall.edge_incidence_proxy_sum_s: sum session elapsed per source-invocation edge; shared prefix repeats only in this hypothetical proxy
wall.source_invocation_proxy_cost_s: sum all mapped session charges for that source invocation, failures and timeouts included
wall.action_mean_invocation_proxy_cost_s: arithmetic mean of every declared source invocation, not fastest/minimum; no fit-target output
wall.arithmetic: Decimal local precision 50; diagnostic strings, division may round at 50 significant digits
wall.cohort: one environment cohort within each invocation and circuit; reject mixed costs
wall.positive_cost: each mapped source invocation/action total strictly positive; individual session zero allowed

legacy_projection_not_yet_implemented_or.actions: select declared identity/role/family/scheme/source UID metadata without accessing candidate-quality values
legacy_projection_not_yet_implemented_or.sessions: join remediation manifest to full parent/session/order lineage by original attempt ID; do not fabricate supplemental metadata
legacy_projection_not_yet_implemented_or.edges: preserve audited mapping_rule and stage/mode/source identity; do not call the old mapping audit as a label-free reader because it reads measurements and quality flags
legacy_projection_not_yet_implemented_or.source_completeness: requires original inventory and exclusions receipt; provided-set graph checks alone do not authenticate coverage
